forward.formal_tests: once after 36 months and last H20 maturity

hypotheses: M1 within-industry medium-term strength and short-term pullback
M2 common rebound and risk compensation
M3 execution date and holding path
evidence: historical post-selection exploration; prior outcomes seen
original_account: E1 expanding original monthly phase1 Q5, not constrained S1
mechanism_sample: original members, finite E1, all13 styles; known L1 with >=10 eligible stocks; >=100 stocks/date; >=50 residual degrees of freedom; no E2 requirement

scores.relative: subtract leave-one-out industry mean, then average-rank percentile (rank-.5)/n

primary_tests.P1: mean weekly H10 conditional J slope
primary_tests.P2: mean paired phase1 H10 main-cost event J minus B
primary_tests.P3: mean weekly H10 E1 rank slope conditional on J and controls

controls: 13 existing styles, industry, intercept, u/v linear and positive-part hinges .25/.5/.75

portfolio.industry_slots: universe-proportional largest remainder, industry-code tie break

placebo.selection: same industry counts and risk tolerances, no best seed selection
